dialogues.speaker: Miztli
dialogues.text: Dear guests, today's "Dreambow Drift" experience has come to a close... Huh? You want to go again?

dialogues.speaker: Miztli
dialogues.text: (For real? I can't believe someone's actually interested in this...)

dialogues.speaker: Miztli
dialogues.text: My apologies, dear guest, but we have no more plans to run "Dreambow Drift" again today. However, we will convey your feedback to our management.
